answer: Pay attesters only for countersigning transactions from outside their own funding cluster. Group each identity into a lagoon: every wallet it funded, or was funded by, in the last 30 days. A countersign inside the same lagoon earns zero, and an identity whose last 50 attestations are over 60 percent in-lagoon has its grading weight cut to 0.25. A sybil farm becomes an island that can only pay itself nothing; to earn, each clone must win real outside work, so it bends toward reach like a willow, which costs real effort per fake.
